## Checklist

### Workflow

- [ ] Branch name follows `<type>/<description>` (see README)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`<type>: <description>`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `dev`, and the target branch is `dev`

### Code

- [ ] Tests were written first and all tests pass
- [ ] Follows MVVM and the naming rules in AGENTS.md
- [ ] New or changed architecture decisions are recorded in `docs/adr/` (or none were made)
- [ ] No warnings, debug prints or commented-out code

### UI and accessibility

- [ ] Checked empty, loading and error states, and edge cases (long text, missing data, repeated taps)
- [ ] Works with the largest Dynamic Type size and has enough color contrast in light and dark mode
- [ ] Controls have clear VoiceOver labels

### Security

- [ ] No secrets (API keys, tokens) committed
- [ ] Sensitive data is stored in the Keychain and never logged
